transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Let's go, Carlos and Lin are late. Nora's sitting in today.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Just listening, mostly. I want to hear where the hip rig is before kitting gets further.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Fine. First thing. We need FL-ANK-1283 by 9/24. Write it down somewhere people look.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: putting it on the board

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Zoe, fixtures, go.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: clamp plate drawing went to the shop yesterday. they said a few days, so maybe end of wk. maybe mon. i'll chase thurs

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: So the question for me is whether the hip rig is usable without the new plate. Can we run the first units on the old one?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: sort of. the old plate works but you have to shim it every time, it adds like ten min per unit

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: That's acceptable for the first two. I'd rather not do it for the full build.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: i rechecked all the dowels yesterday btw, two more were proud on the hip rig, pressed them back

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: the ankle rig ones are all good

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Morning. Forklift was blocking the side door.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Carlos, line, fast.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: First two hip units kitted. Destiny starts pressing bearings today. Short on one housing, we wait.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Two things on that. One, please log the press force on every bearing, not just the first. Two, if anything feels off on the hand turn, set it aside, don't rework it on the line.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Ok. I'll tell Destiny.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: two boxes from the shop came yesterday one is the fixture brackets i think the other has no packing slip

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: the brackets are mine, can you bring them over

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: yeah after this

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: The one with no slip, open it and figure it out. Don't let it sit.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: ok

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Sorry. I was waiting for the chamber tech to call back.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Is he coming?

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Thursday morning. The chamber will be down about half a day for the calibration. Life test isn't affected, it's on its own rig.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay. Then parts. We need nine of the part by 9/22. Is it worth expediting? I'd like an answer today, not Friday.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Depends what it costs. If it's small, just do it.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Is it worth expediting? From the build side, I'd say only if it's on the path for the first units. I'm not sure it is.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: I'll check with Gwen.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: also somebody keeps taking the good calipers from the hip bench

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: the digital ones with the big screen

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: oops. that might be me. they're on the fixture bench

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: lol ok

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Put them back after. Done, everyone go.

summary.overview: Standup with Nora sitting in to check hip rig readiness. New clamp plate at the shop; old plate usable for the first two units with shimming. Dowels rechecked. First hip units kitted, bearing pressing starts today. Chamber cal Thursday. Carlos and Lin late.
shorthand_bullet: clamp plate at shop, est end of wk/mon
old plate ok for first 2 units w/ shim (+~10 min/unit)
2 more proud dowels on hip rig pressed back, ankle rig ok
Nora: log press force every bearing, set aside anything rough
box w/ no packing slip at receiving
chamber cal thurs am, ~half day down
the part x9 by 9/22, expedite? TBD
action_items: Jade bring brackets to fixtures, open unlabeled box
Carlos brief Destiny on press force logging
